correctness.rationale: The second coordinate is constant on each input orbit b. Writing the first coordinate f_b and the second sigma(b), preservation is f_b(a+h)−f_b(a)=sigma(b)−sigma(b−h). For b=0 the first difference is additive in h by composing translations, so sigma is affine with additive linear part L; the same functional equation makes every f_b have linear part L. Additivity is F_p-linearity; reconstruction also gives sufficiency and uniqueness for arbitrary t. For rank r set q=p^r and m=p^(d−r). The q second-coordinate outputs each aggregate m labels, and each label independently chooses one of m image cosets with q representatives. Exactly j occupied cosets give qj points and q^m(m)_j Stirling(m,j) choices. Multiplication over fibers and counting s and rank-r linear maps gives the claimed polynomial; at z=1 each rank summand counts N^N t choices per L,s. Full rank gives a bijection. The greatest proper image is qN at r=d−1 with every coset occupied in every fiber; all lower ranks are strictly smaller, and occupancy there is a bijection on p cosets in each fiber. This proves the gap and endpoint coefficient, including d=1.
residual_risks: Recorded finite check coverage is not an arbitrary-dimension certificate; general correctness rests on the functional equation and occupancy count.
